title: AI开支5万亿美元：信用利差走阔，谁将承压？
speaker: Tracy Chen

segments.en: I think there's just too much supply, and there's a skepticism on the AI trade.
segments.zh: 我认为供给太多，市场对AI交易存在怀疑。

segments.en: But if you look at the global AI arms race between China and the US, it's quite daunting to see which one will slow down.
segments.zh: 但看全球AI竞赛，中美之间谁先放缓都很难说。

segments.en: So I think the hyperscaler in the US, they are forced to just keep building out the infrastructure because the demand for compute is still very huge.
segments.zh: 所以美国的大型云厂商被迫持续扩建基础设施，因为算力需求仍然巨大。

segments.en: And if you look at the core beef, the earnings report, it shows that they have so many backlogs.
segments.zh: 看核心企业的财报，显示他们积压订单非常多。

segments.en: So at the same time, I do think the credit market will have to absorb a lot of supply.
segments.zh: 同时，我认为信用市场将不得不吸收大量供给。

segments.en: That is why I think the credit spread will continue to widen from here, especially the IG part.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我认为信用利差会继续走阔，尤其是投资级部分。

segments.en: And for investors, we have to pick bonds, right? All data center credit are created equal. You can see them trade differently.
segments.zh: 对于配置者来说，我们必须挑选债券。数据中心信用并非都一样，它们的交易表现也不同。

segments.en: It's the investor's concern about which one will be going forward.
segments.zh: 配置者关心的是未来哪个会胜出。

segments.en: So I think JP Morgan estimated there will be $5 trillion of KPACs spending from hyperscalers, so the entire AI built out from now to 2030.
segments.zh: 摩根大通估计，从现在到2030年，云厂商的AI建设支出将达到5万亿美元。

segments.en: And most of the spending will fall IG credit and private credit and high yield and securitize a tiny part of that 5 trillion.
segments.zh: 大部分支出将落在投资级信用、私募信用和高收益债上，证券化只占很小部分。

segments.en: So that's a lot of demand for capital. And that is exactly why I think the cost of capital will go up.
segments.zh: 所以资本需求巨大，这正是我认为资本成本会上升的原因。

segments.en: You can view this as a fiscal stimulus from AI company. So we are going from a government fiscal stimulus to private sector, fiscal stimulus.
segments.zh: 你可以把这看作AI公司的财政刺激。我们正从政府财政刺激转向私营部门的财政刺激。

segments.en: Credit spread, well, well, widen from here, just a matter of supply.
segments.zh: 信用利差会从这里继续走阔，这只是供给问题。
